issues.description: Element: Animal constructor and name accessor methods. Problem statement: the UML and explicit note require protected visibility for the Animal constructor and for the getName()/setName() methods (protected Animal(String), protected String getName(), protected void setName()). Solution repository: Animal.java implements these as public (public Animal(String), public String getName(), public void setName()). This inconsistency between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and access level for Animal's API and may lead to incorrect implementations or unexpected access from external code.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the problem specification: change the access modifiers in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java to protected for the constructor and the name accessor methods (protected Animal(String), protected String getName(), protected void setName(String)). Verify subclasses (Goat, Pig, Seal) still compile and access getName()/setName() as expected. If external tests or example code require public access, update the problem statement to explicitly allow public visibility instead so students are not sent conflicting signals.
